t0=time.time()
E=W('model.embed_tokens.weight'); nw=W('model.embedding_norm.weight')
cls=json.load(open('/work/cls.json'))
mu=E.mean(0)
D=[]
keys=list(cls)
for k in keys:
    d=(E[cls[k]].mean(0)-mu)*nw
    D.append(d/d.norm())
D=torch.stack(D)  # C x 2048
res={}
moe=[L for L in range(24) if L not in (0,1)]
for L in moe:
    S=[]
    for e in range(32):
        w2=W(f'model.layers.{L}.feed_forward.experts.{e}.w2.weight')
        p=(D@w2).norm(dim=1)/w2.norm()*(2048**0.5)
        S.append(p)
    S=torch.stack(S) # 32 x C
    res[L]=S.tolist()
json.dump({'keys':keys,'res':res},open('/work/lens.json','w'))
print(time.time()-t0)
for L in moe:
    S=torch.tensor(res[L]); z=(S-S.mean(0))/S.std(0)
    line=[]
    for c,k in enumerate(keys):
        e=int(z[:,c].argmax()); line.append(f'{k}:e{e}({z[e,c]:.1f})')
